title: Policy Writing & Critique
description: Draft and refine customer-facing policies (e.g., refunds, fair use). Tests boundary setting, clarity, and legal awareness.

seo.overviewTitle: Customer Policy Writing (Refunds, Returns, SLAs & Terms)
seo.overviewBody: Clear customer-facing policies reduce disputes, chargebacks, and legal liability. Operations specialists write transparent refund policies, return guidelines, delivery SLAs, and terms summary documents using plain language while maintaining fraud prevention controls.

deliverables.title: 1. Customer Refund, Return & Cancellation Policy
deliverables.desc: Clear customer-facing policy document detailing eligibility windows, return shipping rules, and refund processing timelines.

deliverables.title: 2. Service Level Agreement (SLA) & Terms Summary
deliverables.desc: Plain-language summary explaining service availability SLAs, response time commitments, and credit remedy terms.

deliverables.title: 3. Policy Exception Matrix for Frontline Agents
deliverables.desc: Internal matrix empowering support agents to grant policy exceptions up to specified financial thresholds.

faqs.question: How does a transparent return policy reduce credit card chargebacks?
faqs.answer: When customers clearly understand return instructions and receive prompt refund confirmations, they are far less likely to file chargeback disputes with their bank.

faqs.question: How do you empower support agents while preventing policy abuse?
faqs.answer: Create a tiered Policy Exception Matrix: Tier 1 agents can issue up to $25 goodwill credits without approval; Tier 2 leads approve up to $100.

faqs.question: Why should customer policies avoid dense legalese?
faqs.answer: Plain-language policies improve customer trust, lower support ticket inquiries asking for policy clarification, and reduce customer frustration.
